Clans and social play

Clan warehouse: why can I deposit but not withdraw?

Clan storage holds weapons, attachments, components and resources. Every member can deposit from their personal Safe, but withdrawals need permission from the leader. If you can only deposit, ask the leader to check the warehouse access list.

Storage is shared across servers. Some clan perks and opened Allowance rewards also supply it. Granting or revoking access notifies the clan, so agree who collects and distributes supplies.
